title: "Han Lie's Fury"
next_chapter_hook: "Seven days later, on that rainy night, Han Lie will experience true despair—Chen Ji has already seen the endpoint of his life, and that ending will come faster and more brutally than anyone imagined."

text.content: "Deep within the Bamboo Grove, Su Qingyao's footsteps faded into the distance as Chen Ji stood alone amidst the mottled light and shadow. He lowered his gaze to the Turtle Shell Fragment in his hand, his fingertips gently tracing those ancient and blurred markings, as if he could sense the boundless mysteries contained within. His father's遗物, Su Qingyao's questioning, and the truth that seemed hidden even deeper—all of these tangled together in his mind like tangled yarn, impossible to sort out. However, just at this moment, a hurried and heavy footsteps broke the tranquility, accompanied by rough and impatient scolding growing closer. Chen Ji slowly raised his head, a subtle cold gleam flickering in the depths of his eyes—looks like trouble has finally come knocking."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji! You stand right there for me!"

text.content: "Before the words even finished, a burly figure burst into the Bamboo Grove like a wild bull, bringing with it a fierce gust of pressure. Han Lie was followed by seven or eight Xuanwu Sect disciples, each with hostile expressions, surrounding Chen Ji completely. Han Lie's tiger-like eyes fixed死死盯着 Chen Ji, flames practically shooting from them as he grit his teeth and said: 'You good-for-nothing! How dare you play tricks on my Xuanwu Sect people! If I don't teach you a lesson today, I'll write my name backwards!' His voice echoed through the Bamboo Grove, carrying undisguised killing intent."

dialogue.content: "What does Brother Han mean by this? I'm merely a Servant Disciple, what courage would I have to play tricks on the heroes of Xuanwu Sect?"

text.content: "Chen Ji slightly bent his waist, a perfectly measured expression of panic and unease appearing on his face. His voice trembled slightly, his hands unconsciously gripping the hem of his clothes, his entire being radiating the humility of the weak. Yet beneath this compliant exterior, his consciousness quietly sank into the depths of his Mental Sea, the yellowed pages of the Tianji Record slowly unfurling. In an instant, an invisible force spread from his Brow Center, and Chen Ji felt his perception rapidly extending—he began to foresee everything that would happen in the next three hours. Time at this moment seemed to become viscous."

"Upon the Tianji Record Fragment, the river of fate began to flow. Chen Ji saw Han Lie's furious face up close, saw the mocking smiles of those Xuanwu Sect disciples, and also saw further away—at the edge of the Bamboo Grove, behind an ancient pine, a gray-robed figure was quietly watching. When that figure slightly tilted its head, Chen Ji caught a clear glimpse of its face: triangular eyes, goatee, a sinister gaze flickering with calculation. This person wore the Xuanqing Taoist Robe only Inner Sect Elders were entitled to wear, and most心惊的是, Han Lie's seemingly impulsive and brainless provocation had inadvertently exchanged an extremely hidden gesture with that person."

dialogue.content: "Don't play dumb with me! My several junior brothers merely wanted to spar with you, yet you set a trap causing them to be injured before the Sect Competition! This debt must be settled today!"

text.content: "Han Lie pressed forward another step, his body, easily twice Chen Ji's size, casting a shadow over Chen Ji. He looked down at Chen Ji from above, a cruel arc curling at the corner of his mouth: 'Now I'm giving you two choices. First, kneel down and磕 three响头 in front of everyone, then滚出 Tianqing Sect forever, never let me see you again. Second—' his voice suddenly turned gloomy, 'I'll handle it personally, and let you know什么叫做生不如死!' The surrounding Xuanwu Sect disciples erupted in mocking laughter, some already rubbing their hands in anticipation, eyes full of the joy of watching a good show."

"Chen Ji's Brow Center twitched slightly—the Tianji Record's foresight clearly told him that the gray-robed Elder hidden behind the ancient pine was nodding almost imperceptibly, clearly very satisfied with Han Lie's performance. More importantly, he saw in that fragment of fate a blurry silhouette—a girl bound by chains, in ragged clothes yet still stubbornly raising her head. That girl's face... Chen Ji's heart trembled violently—it was Chen Nian! His sister! Why would her figure appear in this vision of the conflict? Could it be that... Xuanwu Sect has some connection to this?"

choice.prompt: "Han Lie forces Chen Ji to kneel and apologize, facing such humiliation, how should Chen Ji respond?"

choices.description: "Temporarily bow and kneel to preserve oneself, secretly记下 this debt. As long as the green mountains remain, there's firewood to burn—this fool Han Lie will sooner or later bring about his own destruction."
choices.risk_hint: "Han Lie may become even more presumptuous"

text.content: "Chen Ji's knees slowly bent, and at the moment they were about to touch the ground, his voice rang out low and calm: 'Brother Han is right, I don't understand the rules, I offended those several brothers.' His tone carried no resentment whatsoever, only恰到好处的畏fear. The surrounding Xuanwu Sect disciples let out a sharp round of mocking laughter, someone even spitting at him. Han Lie threw his head back and laughed triumphantly, his laughter echoing through the Bamboo Grove."

dialogue.content: "Hahaha! That's more like it! If you had been this sensible earlier, why suffer all this? Get lost,废物!"

choices.description: "Surface-level courtesy and politeness, actually each word carries barbs. Use words to stimulate Han Lie into losing理智, making him humiliate himself publicly yet not giving him an excuse to act."
choices.visible_reward: "Humiliate Han Lie publicly, accumulate hatred but make him lose composure"

text.content: "Chen Ji slowly straightened his body, his movements very slow, as if deep in contemplation. When he raised his head, that timid look had completely vanished without a trace, replaced by a calm that made everyone present feel uneasy. He slightly bowed, his voice gentle as spring breeze: 'Brother Han's教训 is well taken. I am merely a Servant Disciple, shouldn't have conflicted with the distinguished disciples of Xuanwu Sect in the first place. Just...' he pivoted, a faint smile curling at the corner of his mouth, 'Brother is certain those several junior brothers' injuries were really caused by me?'"

"Han Lie's face instantly turned ashen. He never expected this cowardly废物, who is usually timid as a mouse, would dare confront him publicly today! More critically, Chen Ji's words were airtight—he neither admitted nor denied, simply nonchalantly抛回 the question. The surrounding Xuanwu Sect disciples exchanged glances, some beginning to whisper, their eyes gaining more suspicion. Han Lie felt his威信 being shaken, an even more fierce rage rising from the depths of his heart, nearly burning his reason to ashes."

dialogue.content: "Good! Good! Good! Chen Ji, you have guts!"

text.content: "Han Lie said three 'goods' consecutively, each word seemingly挤出 from between his teeth. He abruptly raised his right hand, a ball of blazing Xuan Flame凝聚ing in his palm—that was his proud Xuanwu True Fire. The flame's temperature caused the surrounding air to distort, bamboo leaves rapidly turning yellow and curling from the heat. 'Since you're so eager to seek death, I'll oblige!' He roared, the Xuan Flame transforming into a ferocious fire snake, carrying the might of destruction as it lunged toward Chen Ji."

"At this critical moment, the depths of Chen Ji's eyes, the Tianji Record Fragment flickered frantically. He saw—the trajectory of his own side-step, saw the opening Han Lie exposed due to going all-out, also saw the angle and speed of that fire snake's approach. Everything was crystal clear, as if fate had spread a detailed map before his eyes. However, the Heavenly Fate consumption was also progressing simultaneously, that number representing the origin of life rapidly dropping. Five points, ten points, fifteen points... Chen Ji clenched his teeth, forcibly suppressing his body's discomfort, focusing all his attention on the impending counterattack."

choice.prompt: "Han Lie goes all-out, victory or defeat in a single instant! How should Chen Ji choose?"

choices.description: "Utilize foresight to precisely dodge while counterattacking simultaneously! Give Han Lie an unforgettable lesson at minimum cost, making him lose face publicly."
choices.visible_cost: "Consume 20 Heavenly Fate points, body suffers backlash"
choices.visible_reward: "Publicly defeat Han Lie, become famous across the three major sects"
choices.risk_hint: "May expose part of Tianji Record's abilities"

text.content: "Chen Ji's body eerily shifted sideways the instant the fire snake approached—that angle was impossibly precise—the fire snake roared past his sleeve yet didn't touch a single thread of fabric. 'What!' Han Lie's pupils contracted sharply, he had no time to react before feeling a sharp pain in his abdomen. Chen Ji's fist had somehow already slammed into his Dantian, that seemingly soft and powerless attack yet contained a hidden force that shocked the nerves. Han Lie's Xuan Flame instantly extinguished, his entire person flying backward like a severed kite, crashing heavily onto a massive rock over thirty feet away, shattering it into pieces."

dialogue.content: "Impossible! How could a废物 like you... cough..."

choices.description: "Don't confront head-on, use clever strength to neutralize the attack.顺势 fall to the ground feigning injury, which can both preserve life and bring bigger trouble for Han Lie."
choices.visible_reward: "Use a blade to kill—make Han Lie offend more factions"
choices.risk_hint: "May be seen through by Han Lie"

text.content: "Chen Ji's body顺势 fell the instant the fire snake approached, he deliberately let his sleeve catch fire, rolling on the ground several times before extinguishing the flames. When he stood up, his hair was singed black, his clothes torn and ragged, looking utterly miserable. Yet at that moment, a stern shout came from the edge of the Bamboo Grove: 'Stop! Han Lie, what boldness! Daring to use Xuanwu True Fire within the sect!' The gray-robed Elder finally revealed himself, his gaze lingering on Chen Ji for a moment, his brow furrowing almost imperceptibly. Obviously, his plan had been disrupted by Han Lie's loss of control."

"No matter what choice Chen Ji makes, the gears of fate have already begun to turn. That gray-robed Elder—Tianqing Sect Law Enforcement Elder Zhang Shen—was now walking over with a gloomy face. His gaze like a blade, scanning back and forth between Chen Ji and Han Lie, finally fixing on Han Lie's disheveled form. 'Han Lie,' his voice cold as ice water in the depth of winter, 'the Sect Competition is imminent, instead of preparing for battle at Xuanwu Sect, you come to Tianqing Sect to make trouble? Has Xuanwu Sect become so impoverished that they need to intimidate a Servant Disciple to boost their reputation?' These words seemed to defend Chen Ji, yet every word was pushing Xuanwu Sect into a deeper public relations quagmire."

dialogue.content: "Elder Zhang, you... what do you mean by this!"

text.content: "Chen Ji stood to the side, his face pale as paper, lips slightly trembling, his entire being radiating the weakness of someone who just escaped death. Yet his mind was racing—Tianji Record's vision flashed again, in those blurry fragments he saw Zhang Shen conversing with a black-robed figure in a secret chamber, saw a document filled with Chen Nian's name being secretly transferred, saw even more clearly the earth-shaking upheaval seven days later... all clues pointed to a chilling possibility: his sister Chen Nian had some hidden connection to this seemingly simple conflict. And Han Lie was merely a pawn pushed to the front stage."

"Han Lie clutched his Dantian, stumbling to his feet. His originally proud face was now filled with disbelief and humiliation, crimson eyes glaring at Chen Ji, teeth grinding. 'Chen Ji... remember this...' his voice hoarse and cold, 'At the Sect Competition seven days from now, I will personally tear you to pieces! I will let you know the consequences of offending me, Han Lie!' With that, he fiercely glared at Zhang Shen, leading the Xuanwu Sect disciples to slink away from the Bamboo Grove. Only when those heavy footsteps completely faded did Chen Ji slowly raise his head, his gaze passing through Zhang Shen to fall on some invisible corner in the distant future—where the threads of fate were quietly weaving."

choice.prompt: "Han Lie departs wounded, Elder Zhang Shen seems to have something to say, how should Chen Ji respond?"

choices.description: "Pretend to be injured and weak, take the opportunity to试探 Zhang Shen's true attitude. This Elder's appearance is too coincidental, cannot fail to be on guard."

text.content: "Chen Ji's body swayed, one knee hitting the ground, he covered his chest with his hand, coughing violently. Several strands of blood seeped from the corner of his mouth, he raised his head, using a weak yet grateful gaze to look at Zhang Shen: 'Many thanks to Elder Zhang for rescuing me, if not for the Elder's timely arrival, I would have been buried here today...' His voice was断续的, his acting impeccable. Yet beneath this compliant posture, his peripheral vision never left Zhang Shen's triangular eyes—those eyes contained a calm and calculation completely incompatible with his performance."

dialogue.content: "Rise, no need for formalities. Tell me, why does Han Lie have a grudge against you?"

choices.description: "Directly question Zhang Shen why he happened to appear here. A Law Enforcement Elder shouldn't coincidentally appear in a remote Bamboo Grove."

text.content: "Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, his movements slow, yet every gesture exuded a气质 completely different from before. His gaze calmly fell on Zhang Shen's face, no fear, no gratitude, only a淡然 that saw through everything. 'Elder Zhang,' his voice soft yet each word clear, 'I have one thing I don't understand. A Law Enforcement Elder's affairs are busy, why would you have leisure to come to this remote Bamboo Grove today? Could it be... Elder has been secretly paying attention to my every move?' At these words, Zhang Shen's expression slightly changed, the smile in those triangular eyes freezing for a moment."

"Zhang Shen's gaze flickered for an instant, then quickly restored that kind facade. He stepped forward, reaching out to touch Chen Ji's shoulder, the gesture seemingly concerned yet actually hiding试探. Chen Ji silently sidestepped, Zhang Shen's hand missed its target, his brow furrowing almost imperceptibly. 'Nephew Chen Ji overthinking it,' Zhang Shen smiled, his voice gentle as an elder caring for a junior, 'This old man was merely conducting routine patrols, coincidentally passing by. Rather it is Nephew, that Han Lie is indeed arrogant, but his Xuanwu True Fire is no joke—were you hurt anywhere?' As he spoke, his gaze absent-mindedly swept over Chen Ji's chest, as if searching for something."

"Just then, a Spiritual Light flashed through Chen Ji's mind—the Tianji Record Fragment reappeared, that was the foresight image about seven days later. In those blurry images, he clearly saw Han Lie lying in a pool of blood, and standing before him was a blurry yet familiar silhouette. In that silhouette's hand seemed to be a token gleaming with幽光—the token's markings were identical to the decorative patterns on the edge of the Tianji Record Fragment! Chen Ji's heart tightened sharply, this discovery threw his thoughts into brief chaos. He forced himself to pull his focus back, discovering Zhang Shen was watching himself with a scrutinizing gaze, the profound meaning in those eyes making his back break out in a fine cold sweat."

"Han Lie clutched his Dantian, stumbling to his feet. His originally proud face was now filled with disbelief and humiliation, crimson eyes glaring at Chen Ji, teeth grinding. 'Chen Ji... remember this...' his voice hoarse and cold, 'At the Sect Competition seven days from now, I will personally tear you to pieces! I will let you know the consequences of offending me, Han Lie!' With that, he fiercely glared at Zhang Shen, leading the Xuanwu Sect disciples to slink away from the Bamboo Grove. Only when those heavy footsteps completely faded did Chen Ji slowly raise his head, his gaze passing through Zhang Shen to fall on some invisible corner in the distant future—where the threads of fate were quietly weaving. Seven days later at the Sect Competition, Han Lie will meet his doom. And before that, Chen Ji still has far too many things to prepare, to plan. The complete version of the Tianji Record, the mysteries his father left behind, his sister Chen Nian's whereabouts... all of these will, on that stormy and rainy night, welcome their final unveiling."
